content.title: About
content.content: Greek strawberry nonfat yogurt is a thick, protein‑rich dairy product made by double‑straining whole milk. Added natural strawberry gives it a sweet fruit flavor, while the lack of fat keeps it low‑calorie.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Greek yogurt contains 2–3 times more protein than regular yogurt.
Strawberries are one of the richest sources of vitamin C and antioxidants.
The nonfat version retains all the nutritional benefits of milk without added fat.
Traditional straining creates a creamier, denser texture.
Greek yogurt is often used as a substitute for sour cream or mayo in recipes.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: A 200 ml serving provides about 20 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The nonfat version contains roughly 80 kcal per 100 g, making it suitable for weight management.

items.title: Rich in probiotics
items.content: Live cultures promote a healthy gut microbiome and aid digestion.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Strawberries add vitamin C, potassium and folate, while the dairy base supplies calcium and vitamin D.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Antioxidants from strawberries help combat free radicals.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort; choose brands with added lactase if needed.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Casein and whey can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Some brands sweeten the product; check the label if you monitor sugar intake.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature may irritate the stomach lining of those with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy it as a snack, blend into smoothies, use as a base for sauces, dressings or desserts. Pair with nuts, seeds or whole‑grain cereals for extra texture and flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1–4 °C. After opening, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
